notes: Complete second reading by a different reader from the first reading. The whole image and each existing native overlapping half were viewed once. Every text line, display, index, punctuation mark, deletion, insertion and slanted margin was compared against consolidated/C/H; all 24 inventory elements were matched, with no missing element found.

The opening singular essentielle triviale, the repeated/overwritten display number 28, the literal Et de = shorthand, the potentially plural inserted un 1-cocycles, and resp! are preserved. Clear authorial forms were not normalized.

Eight existing doubtful loci were individually reconsidered. Seven retain their exact consolidated form; the after-l locus receives a broader explicit uncertainty that favors live ellipsis plus a canceled l-like sign while retaining canceled en l.

Two supplied periods have no independent ink: the point before Ici and the terminal point in the diagonal margin. These are separate proposed removals, independently assessable from the same saved crops already used in the first reading.

One new crop was necessary for the newly unresolved endpoint of the path arrow in (28), lying above the existing first_display_end crop. It confirms the arrow, so it causes no textual correction. No old locus was recropped.

No OCR, external research, TeX compilation, regenerated half, or other page source was used. No new mathematical proof, computation, or checked theorem-use was undertaken; the earlier check events are not copied into this audit as new work.

After the auditor reported the three proposed changes, the main reader independently reused iso_and_deleted and margin and agreed that neither period is visible and that the ellipsis/canceled-l preference should retain the alternative cancellation boundary. The audit still submits exact before/after changes for root adjudication.
